definitions.explanation: The act of throwing away or selling something no longer needed.
A penalty or action taken against someone who has done wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{処分|しょぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{不用品|ふようひん}→不用品：03146_fuyouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{処分|しょぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引っ越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{処分|しょぶん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I disposed of old furniture before moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{懲戒|ちょうかい}→懲戒：09469_choukai⟧{処分|しょぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{処分|しょぶん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The employee who violated the rules was disciplined.

examples.english: The misconduct was discovered, and a severe punishment was handed down.

notes:
{処分|しょぶん} has two distinct meanings: disposing of unwanted items, and taking disciplinary action. Context determines which meaning applies.

SENSE 1 - DISPOSAL:
- ⟦{不用品|ふようひん}→不用品：03146_fuyouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{処分|しょぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: dispose of unwanted items
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{処分|しょぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: dispose of documents
- {処分|しょぶん}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: clearance/disposal items (for sale)

SENSE 2 - PUNISHMENT:
- ⟦{懲戒|ちょうかい}→懲戒：09469_choukai⟧{処分|しょぶん}: disciplinary action
- {処分|しょぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive punishment
- {処分|しょぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}す→下す：12329_kudasu⟧: to hand down a punishment
